newsitem.title: UK: Copper stays easier in LME evening, above low.
newsitem.headline: Copper stays easier in LME evening, above low.

text.p: Copper prices managed to remain above the earlier $2,230 4-1/2 month low during LME evening inter-office trading, but still closed substantially lower.
Traders said the market, which had fallen from levels near $2,370 in 24 hours, did need to consolidate after the speculative selling blizzard it had been hit with.
"It has been bloodied today, and there is probably more to come," a trader said.
Stocks are rising, demand is slowing for the summer, and the July tightness, although still evident, is less intense, traders noted.
At 1800 gmt three months copper was quoted at $2,240/45 a tonne, a key chart support level. It earlier finished the kerb at $2,236, having spiralled down from $2,368 on Tuesday.
Aluminium remained around closing kerb levels at $1,562/65 a tonne.
